title: Microwave-assisted synthesis and in vitro and in silico studies of pyrano[3,2-c]quinoline-3-carboxylates as dual acting anti-cancer and anti-microbial agents and potential topoisomerase II and DNA-gyrase inhibitors
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1941-1956
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06201A, Paper
Open Access

Ashraf A. Aly, Hisham A. Abd El-Naby, Essam Kh. Ahmed, Sageda A. Gedamy, Kari Rissanen, Martin Nieger, Alan B. Brown, Michael G. Shehat, Marwa M. Shaaban, Amal Atta
A microwave-assisted method was utilized to synthesize novel pyranoquinolone derivatives as dual acting topoisomerase II/DNA gyrase inhibitors with apoptosis induction ability for halting lung cancer and staphylococcal infection.
